feeds.title: GnomeAngel Blog
feeds.description: My name is Angie and I started GnomeAngel.com in 2008 and while the topics that I've covered have been in constant evolution the one thing that hasn't changed is my passion for sharing, inspiring and creating quilts. I love writing about the things that are captivating me, intriguing me and just causing me to run around the house like a lunatic. My mission is to inspire people to follow their dreams through the sharing of my passion for being creative.

feeds.title: Tazzie Quilts
feeds.description: Can we have it all? I love to quilt, and work as much stitching into my day as I can, along with being a wife, mum of 2, and sometimes I even play house!

feeds.title: Quilting Twin
feeds.description: I'm 59 years old, an identical twin, mother of DD31 and DS30. I live in country South Australia and run my own quilting and pattern business with my sister.

feeds.title: Fairholme Quilters
feeds.description: We are a group of quilters of all skill and experience levels who have been meeting in Sydney's northern suburbs, since 1984. Our members are interested in all types of patchwork and quilting.

feeds.title: Craftapalooza Designs Blog
feeds.description: Access quirky quilt designs and other useful resources. Nic Vaughan is an Australian quilter and quilt pattern designer with a passion for handwork. She is on a mission to introduce quilters to the glimmers that hand-sewing patchwork by hand gives. Her vibrant and quirky use of fabrics makes her work instantly recognizable.

feeds.title: Make Modern Blog
feeds.description: We're a small team of passionate quilters from around Australia, working with a huge team of contributors worldwide. Our obsession with living and breathing all things quilting led to the creation of Make Modern, so we could share our passion with quilters everywhere. Keep up-to-date with all things quilting with our collection of blog posts. If you're searching for inspiration, tips, and tricks or just wanting to learn something new - you've come to the right place!

feeds.title: Lyn Keogh Quilts Blog
feeds.description: Lyn Keogh Quilts is a heartfelt quilting blog where Lyn shares her creative journey—showcasing detailed projects, award-winning quilts, and the evolution of her patchwork, appliqué, and quilting techniques.

feeds.title: Chookyblue........
feeds.description: Chookyblue's blog offers a cozy glimpse into life in the 'chook shed' — a warm blend of sewing, photography, gardening, farming adventures, and the occasional family cameo.

feeds.title: William Morris in Quilting
feeds.description: A personal quilting blog by Michele Hill featuring William Morris inspired applique, quilting projects, exhibition news, and creative life in rural Australia.

feeds.title: 3 and 3 Quarters
feeds.description: This is a Sydney based Modern quilting blog giving you all the information on new quilting techniques.

feeds.title: Supreme Quilts Blog
feeds.description: Supreme Quilts' blog offers curated insights, advice, and trends on premium down bedding—from selecting the ideal quilt for Australia's climate to care tips and lifestyle elevating sleep comfort.

feeds.title: Geometriquilt
feeds.description: Geometriquilt blends geometry, quilt design, and creative inspiration through weekly 'Sunday sketch' quilt patterns and finished projects, encouraging adventurous quilting and personal design exploration.

feeds.title: Quilt Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on our latest news about quilting classes in Brisbane, Ipswich and Grandvale through the Quilt Therapy Blog. Nurturing the Art of Quilting.

feeds.title: ButterZ
feeds.description: ButterZ (Jo Butterfield's blog) is a heartfelt quilting journal where Jo shares her ongoing stitch-along projects, finishes like placemats and quilts, and creative charity makes—celebrating crafting one quilt, border, and binding at a time.

feeds.title: Patch n Quilt Blog
feeds.description: The Patch n Quilt blog offers a wealth of quilting inspiration, featuring a variety of quilt patterns, project ideas, and creative techniques. It serves as a valuable resource for quilters of all skill levels, providing insights into different quilting styles, fabric choices, and design ideas. Whether you're looking for traditional patterns or modern twists, the blog showcases a diverse range of projects to inspire your next quilting endeavor.

feeds.title: Online Quilt Magazine
feeds.description: Welcome to our Online Quilt Magazine Blog. Read through to discover hints and tips, articles from magazine contributors, sneak peeks, and more!

feeds.title: Aussie Hero Quilts Blog
feeds.description: News & Updates Welcome to the Aussie Hero Quilts (and Laundry Bags) Blog. This page contains all of our wonderful blog posts and will help keep you up to date with all that is happening with Aussie Hero Quilts. Weekly Dispatch 15th August 2025 by AHQ | 15 August 2025 | Weekly Dispatches | 0

feeds.title: OZQN Blog
feeds.description: Showcasing Australia's vibrant art‑quilting community, the Ozquilt Network blog features exhibition highlights, artist profiles, and calls for entries—celebrating creativity and connection across the art‑quilt world.

feeds.title: WA Quilters Blog
feeds.description: A vibrant hub showcasing updates on quilting events, workshops, exhibitions, and community projects by the West Australian Quilters Association.

feeds.title: SUSIES-SCRAPS.COM
feeds.description: Fabric and food are a constant inspiration for me. I'm always creating something new and coming up with ideas for quilts, baskets bags and scrap fabric projects. I also love fabric scraps. They provide inspiration for quilts, baskets, bags, mats, twine and other sewing projects.

feeds.title: Red Pepper Quilts
feeds.description: A blog about fabric, patchwork and quilts. Ritas quilting style is fresh and modern; using really simple and often traditional design ideas to make colorful quilts. Her blog is a journal of her creative self, and she hope to show readers that easy to make quilts can be really striking, and that by taking small risks in fabric and color selection the final product won't disappoint. It is all about sharing her knowledge, and hope inspire others to pick up the rotary cutter and use their fabric stash.

feeds.title: WOMBAT QUILTS
feeds.description: Welcome to my little piece of the blogasphere. My name is Cath and this Blog is a record of my quilting adventure which involves quite a bit of colour and lots of paper piecing.

feeds.title: Koolkat's Quilting Blog
feeds.description: A journal through quilts, UFOs and ideas and various trivia. Mission is to To provide excellent service and advice for our quilting customers, and a range of original quilt patterns and kits for the enjoyment of quilters. Run by Kathy Adams.

feeds.title: Happy In Quilting
feeds.description: I am happily married to James and have been for 34 years, we have three sons Luke 30 and twins Chris and Josh 28. We have two dogs, our little man Ollie he is a Spoodle, and our other little mate Tarj he is a Chihuahua.

feeds.title: Aussie Quilters Cotton Club
feeds.description: An Aussie Quilter from downunder. I live in Australia on the east coast of New South Wales and in the beautiful city of Lake Macquarie.

feeds.title: The Guilty Quilter
feeds.description: A charming and skillful quilting blog by Phil Thomas—also known as The Guilty Quilter—that shares tutorials, workshop experiences, pictorial inspirations, and personal quilting projects from Australia to New Zealand.

feeds.title: Melinda Keily Quilts Blog
feeds.description: Melinda Keily Quilts' blog shares the creation of personalized memorial quilts, exploring art, healing, and community storytelling.

feeds.title: My Nanna Does That Blog
feeds.description: A heartfelt quilting journey by Nellie (Janelle Skene), sharing creative stories, pattern releases, and personal reflections through the art of quilting.

feeds.title: Stitch and Yarn Blog
feeds.description: On the Stitch & Yarn blog you'll find additional pattern tips, colourways, tutorials and the occasional sewalong.
